plan.summary: Consolidation week after the 44.3 km peak in W25. Target 35-38 km with one quality tempo session, a step-back long run of 18 km, and three gym sessions to make up for the strength deficit. Monday run+gym re-establishes the early-week habit that was missed in W25.

sessions.description: Easy run Zone 2 — 6 km at 6:30-7:00/km + Gym (Legs)
Tempo run — 2 km warm-up + 3 km at threshold pace (5:00-5:15/km) + 1 km cool-down
Rest day — active recovery before long run
Long run — 18 km at easy pace (6:20-6:50/km) — consolidation step-back after last week's 21.1 km
